lines.text: O-M-G, I have got to have this!
Everyone knows Royal Road is the ultimate dating hotspot. Why's that? Because there's more brand stores there than you can count, that's why!
One-hour flash sale, half-off all high heels? I do already own a couple hundred pairs... but what's the harm in a couple more!
Oh dear, now I've gone and done it... I went a little overboard buying you some gifts!

Hey you fellow shopaholics!
Guess who I've got with me?
Sweetie, should we choose a place for our date? We can make a reservation at a restaurant and select a decent hotel... Huh? Are we moving too fast?

Sweetie, what are you up to? 
Let's go out to make some money that we can splurge on our next shopping spree!
I'm not boring you, am I? I haven't heard a peep out of you.
There's some super duper stuff in the Outpost Mall!
I'm going to shoot an unboxing video later. Want to say hi to my fans, Sweetie?
Oh my gosh, this bag... I can't even! Give it to me now!
Making a fortune doesn't mean much if you're spending a fortune at the same time!
Whoa, I'm getting stronger!
Now I've got more energy to shop!
Upgraded!
Oh, my. Thank you, Sweetie.
This has been on my wish list for a while!
I... I'm touched...
Hey Sweetie, you know how much I care about you, right?
Oh Sweetie, I like you so much more than before. At least thiiiisssss much more!
Now it's the moment of truth! If I had to choose between you and shopping? It will be extremely painful to give up shopping, but I'd still choose you!
Leave it to me!
What's the plan?
On my way!
Let's get started!
The sooner we're done here, the sooner I can go shopping!
Hot stuff, coming through!
Money is power, after all!
Reloading.
Umm... Yeah.
Preparing.
Cash Cannon is ready to go!
Shopaholic-shot!
Last year's fashion. Time to go!
I got it!
Lucky!
Perfect shot!
Ow!
Ouch!
Heh...
Uh, uh... I could have done better.
When it comes to dominating the competition, nothing beats cold hard cash!
How do I look, Sweetie? I think I really pull this look off.
Personally, I prefer cold hard cash over carrots.
If you have enough money, luck will follow.

I prepared this outfit just for you!
Pretty sexy, don't you think?

I also learned how to pole dance! 
I can give you a show in private later☆

Sweetie, do you like this outfit?
If you do, I've got plenty more just like it.

Sweetie, when are you coming?
What if I get abducted?

Bunny Rupee hit the jackpot, E-I-E-I-O~
And dear old Sweetie is hers as well, E-I-E-I-O~

Congratulations on finding the limited-edition Bunny Rupee!
Today is your lucky day!
Come explore Coin Rush with me today!

Why don't we play a round at Coin Rush?
The loser has to do whatever the winner asks them to.
Introducing the brand new, limited-edition Bunny Rupee ☆
I've become stronger, so now I can spend more money!
Bunny powers... increase!
I feel like I can take on the world!
Aw, thank you so much, Sweetie!
Is this the latest model? This is wonderful!
Oh my gosh! I've got to show this off to the Shopaholics later!
At this rate, I'm gonna fall head over heels for you, Honeybuns.
I, Bunny Rupee, have finally found my companion!
Did I ever tell you how much I love you?
I'm ready!
Lemme perk my ears up...
A hop, skip and a jump!
Bring it on!
I'll show you what money can do!
When this is over, I'm going on a shopping spree.
How much do these cost?
Transferring funds...
Hurry up!
Wait!
Calculations complete!
My treat today! Luxury bunny blast!
Great! Let's bring it home, girls!
Lucky!
OK, next!
Nice shot!
Ouch!
Ow!
This is too much!
*Sob* I'm sorry, Sweetie.
Money talks, my non-bunny friends.
